note: Grants trained in the Lore skill of a second background — modeled as one free Lore choice; the second-background linkage itself is not representable.
Unconditional trained rank in one of four named Lore skills.
Also grants trained in occult spell attack rolls/DCs (spellcasting, not representable) and a free Lore if already trained in both listed Lores.
Unconditional trained rank in both named Lore skills.
Unconditionally grants trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC — spellcasting proficiency has no field in this schema, so nothing could be represented.
Unconditionally grants trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC (Cha) — spellcasting proficiency is not representable in this schema.

Grants trained in spell attack modifier/spell DC plus trained (expert at 8th, master at 16th) in the chosen apparition's skills — apparition skills vary by apparition and spellcasting has no field, so neither could be represented.
Character gains expert in spell attack modifier and spell DC (the hierophant's trained rank is an ally grant and is excluded); spellcasting proficiency is not representable in this schema.

Grants trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, increasing to expert at 11th level — spellcasting proficiency has no field here, so the grant and its 11th-level upgrade could not be represented.
Unconditionally grants trained in spell attacks and spell DCs ("if you were not already" is a non-downgrade clause) — spellcasting proficiency is not representable in this schema.

Trains you in a second common background's skills — modelled as the usual background pattern (one skill + one Lore); the actual pair is constrained by the background chosen, which could not be represented.
Unconditionally raises Fortitude save proficiency to master.
Unconditional weapon-category raise; unarmed is deliberately not included.
Unconditional Perception raise (expert in Perception is only the prerequisite).
Unconditional Fortitude raise to master (expert in Fortitude is only the prerequisite).
Unconditionally raises ONE player-chosen save (Fort/Ref/Will) to master, but the schema has no save-choice field, so the grant could not be represented — needs a saveChoices lane.
Unconditional Reflex raise to master (expert in Reflex is only the prerequisite).
Unconditionally grants trained spell attack modifier + spell DC — a spellcasting proficiency with no field in this schema; already modeled in core.json as spellcastingGrant (divine/cha/trained).
Unconditionally grants trained spell attack modifier + spell DC (cha) — spellcasting proficiency, no field in this schema, and core.json is MISSING a spellcastingGrant for this feat.

Grants the Additional Lore feat for Gladiatorial Lore (unconditional trained, plus its own 3rd/7th/15th skill increases via the granted feat); the extra Lore-of-choice is conditional on already being trained, so it is not recorded as a loreChoice.
Unconditionally trained (expert if already an occult caster) in occult spell attack rolls/DCs; spellcasting proficiency has no field in this schema.
Same as Words of Unraveling: trained/expert in occult spell attack rolls and DCs; spellcasting proficiency not representable here.

Character becomes trained in the chosen eidolon type's listed skills (already-trained ones convert to a free skill) - varies by eidolon type, so not statically representable; the eidolon's own proficiencies are companion-side and excluded.
Trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs of the eidolon's tradition; spellcasting proficiency has no field in this schema.
Trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for the chosen tradition; spellcasting proficiency not representable here.
Unconditionally raises the character's Perception proficiency to master.

Unconditionally trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC (spellcasting proficiency, no schema field); the beast-gun clause only remaps advanced firearms to martial for proficiency purposes and grants no rank.
Trained in divine spell attacks and spell DCs (Cha); spellcasting proficiency has no field in this schema.
Trained in divine spell attack rolls and spell DCs (Wis); spellcasting proficiency not representable in this schema.
Trained in divine spell attack rolls and spell DCs (Cha) for the Lay on Hands focus spell; spellcasting proficiency has no field here.
Trained in spell attack modifiers and DCs is permanent (the once-per-day limit applies to the innate spell only); spellcasting proficiency not representable.
Trained in divine spell attacks and spell DCs when you gain the feat; spellcasting proficiency has no field in this schema.
Choose Deception or Diplomacy (trained); if already trained in both, the grant becomes a free skill of your choice instead - that fallback is not modelled.

Unconditionally trained with bo staff, chakram, katar, panabas and urumi and shifts martial/advanced vanara weapons down one category - per-weapon grants and category remapping cannot be expressed with a category-only weapon field.
Unconditionally trained with blowgun, fighting fan, kris, kukri and shuriken plus a category downshift for vishkanyan weapons - per-weapon grant, not representable as a weapon category.
Trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC for the granted arcane spontaneous casting (Cha); spellcasting proficiency has no field in this schema.
Trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Society; the 'already trained in both -> any skill' fallback is not modelled.
Trained in the skill tied to the chosen hold emblem: Burning Sun/Diplomacy, Death's Head/Survival, Defiled Corpse/Religion, Empty Hand/Intimidation.
Either/or with different ranks (Occultism branch is expert) - recorded at trained to avoid over-granting; occult spell attack/DC not representable; core.json already models this as effectChoices.

If already trained in Arcana it is instead a free skill choice (generic fallback lane); polearm/spear weapon familiarity and mythic proficiency are not rank grants; the 16th-level sentence is garbled in source but clearly means master.
Unconditional two-step increase (one expert to master, another trained to expert); the prerequisite line is the gate, not a condition on the grant.
Thaumaturge archetype feat; 'expert in Will' is a feat prerequisite, the grant itself is unconditional.
Unconditional Perception increase; 'expert in Perception' is only the feat prerequisite.
